SYNTHETIC AIRCRAFT LEASE AGREEMENT

Agreement Number: SYN-LEASE-2026-001

This synthetic test agreement is made between Northstar Aviation Leasing Ltd. (the "Lessor") and Example Airways Ltd. (the "Lessee").

1. AIRCRAFT

Aircraft Registration: G-SYN1
Aircraft MSN: 98765

2. TERM

Effective Date: 1 January 2026.
Expiration Date: 31 December 2031.

3. RENT

The Lessee shall pay monthly rent of USD 250,000 on the first business day of each month.

4. MAINTENANCE AND AIRWORTHINESS

The Lessee shall maintain the Aircraft in an airworthy condition and comply with the approved maintenance programme.

5. INSURANCE

The Lessee shall maintain hull and liability insurance throughout the Term and provide renewal evidence no later than 15 days before policy expiry.

6. TECHNICAL RECORDS

Within 10 business days after each shop visit, the Lessee shall provide complete maintenance records to the Lessor.

7. RETURN CONDITIONS

On the Expiration Date, the Lessee shall return the Aircraft with complete technical records and in the condition required by this Agreement.

8. TERMINATION AND NOTICE

The Lessor may terminate this Agreement following an uncured material default. Notice must be given within 30 days after the default notice.

9. COMPLIANCE

The Lessee shall operate the Aircraft in compliance with applicable aviation laws and airworthiness directives.

10. GOVERNING LAW

This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.

END OF SYNTHETIC TEST AGREEMENT
